_comment: Mock OTEL provider definitions. Each entry becomes a local server that imitates a real observability vendor's ingest endpoint (OTLP/HTTP + the vendor's native API paths) and shows what it received in a branded web UI. Ports here are defaults; --base-port shifts them all.

providers.name: Sumo Logic
providers.docs: Imitates a Sumo Logic OTLP/HTTP Source (collectors.sumologic.com/receiver/v1/otlp/<id>).

providers.name: Datadog
providers.docs: Imitates the Datadog intake + APM trace agent API.

providers.name: New Relic
providers.docs: Imitates the New Relic Metric/Trace/Log API + OTLP endpoint.

providers.name: Honeycomb
providers.docs: Imitates the Honeycomb events API (/1/batch/<dataset>) + OTLP.

providers.name: Grafana Cloud
providers.docs: Imitates the Grafana Cloud OTLP gateway / Loki / Mimir push APIs.

providers.name: Splunk Observability
providers.docs: Imitates Splunk Observability (SignalFx ingest) + HEC + OTLP.

providers.name: Dynatrace
providers.docs: Imitates the Dynatrace OTLP + metrics/logs ingest API.

providers.name: Elastic Observability
providers.tagline: APM · Logs · Metrics on the Elastic Stack
providers.docs: Imitates the Elastic APM Server intake + OTLP endpoint.
